elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: TrueLink assigns Client all right, title and interest in deliverables and work product created specifically for Client during the Support Services.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that TrueLink “hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest” in the specified deliverables and work product.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The assignment excludes TrueLink Intellectual Property existing before, or developed independently of, the Support Services; TrueLink also retains its ownership rights in the Interface.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The licence to TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded in deliverables is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The embedded-IP licence is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The embedded-IP licence is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Client retains all right, title and interest in all Client data and borrower, applicant, customer and broker data, including Credit Data.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Section 8(d) instead permits TrueLink to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data, subject only to the Non-Competition Agreement—not solely to provide the Services.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause disclaims joint ownership of Client Content, Client IP and Client data; deliverables are assigned entirely to Client, while excluded TrueLink IP remains TrueLink's.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: TrueLink Intellectual Property expressly includes tools and know-how, and pre-existing or independently developed TrueLink IP is excluded from the assignment.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Client receives ownership of the deliverables, a stronger continuing right than a perpetual licence; embedded TrueLink IP is also licensed perpetually.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Client receives ownership of the deliverables, which is stronger than an irrevocable licence; the embedded-IP licence is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: Client receives all right, title and interest in the deliverables without a territorial limitation, and the necessary embedded-IP licence is expressly worldwide.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables, and the licence covering embedded TrueLink IP is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables, and the embedded-IP licence expressly permits use and modification for Client's business.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables, and the embedded-IP licence expressly permits sublicensing for Client's business.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: The preserved Credit Data licence authorizes broad distribution, licensing, resale and exploitation and is not limited to processing solely to provide the Services.
